name: gcwork
description: Run tasks with your local Codex from WorkBuddy. Pick the model and reasoning effort; interrupted tasks can be resumed.

displayDescription.en: Hand tasks to your local Codex from WorkBuddy. Pick the model and reasoning effort; interrupted tasks can be resumed.
displayDescription.zh: 在 WorkBuddy 中调用本机 Codex 执行任务，可指定模型和思考强度，中断可续。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 查一下 Codex 能不能用，现在有哪些模型，各自支持什么思考强度。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Check whether Codex is ready, which models I can use, and what reasoning effort each supports.

quickPrompts.zh: 查一下 Codex 能不能用，现在有哪些模型，各自支持什么思考强度。
quickPrompts.en: Check whether Codex is ready, which models I can use, and what reasoning effort each supports.

quickPrompts.zh: 用 Codex 把 src 里的 TODO 全部实现掉，改完跑一遍测试。
quickPrompts.en: Use Codex to implement every TODO under src, then run the tests.

quickPrompts.zh: 用 Codex 只读审查这个项目，不要改文件，模型用 gpt-6.1-sol，思考强度 high。
quickPrompts.en: Have Codex review this project read-only without touching files, using gpt-6.1-sol at high reasoning effort.
